name: 06-history-names-completion
description: names_behavior = COMPLETION (openai.js:206-211; the brief calls it ALWAYS). It is the only branch that puts a name on a chat turn: a valid OpenAI name is used as-is, anything else goes through PromptManager.sanitizeName (PromptManager.js:1343-1351). The reference reads it from promptManager.serviceSettings (openai.js:957), the port from its names_behavior argument; the recorded chat compares the resulting names.
